abstract: To mitigate losses of fresh fruits and vegetables (FFVs), new technologies are increasingly developed across different stages of the supply chain. This study examines how international technology diffusion—specifically innovations targeting FFV loss at the production and transportation stages—affects bilateral trade. We develop a gravity framework grounded in a Melitz‐Pareto model and construct a novel dataset linking patent transfers from the EPO's PATSTAT database to 72 FFV products. Empirical results show that each additional patent transferred from an innovator to a recipient country increases the recipient's exports to the innovator, primarily through growth along the extensive margin. Transportation‐stage technologies, which facilitate export market entry in the technology‐recipient country, exert a stronger effect on exports than production‐stage innovations. Results are robust across PPML, OLS, lagged OLS, and IV estimations. Overall, the findings highlight the critical role of international technology diffusion in lowering entry barriers and promoting trade in perishable goods.
abstract_zh: 为减少新鲜果蔬（FFVs）的损失，供应链各环节的新技术日益涌现。本研究探讨国际技术扩散——特别是针对生产和运输阶段FFV损失的技术创新——如何影响双边贸易。我们基于Melitz-Pareto模型构建了一个引力框架，并创建了一个新颖的数据集，将EPO的PATSTAT数据库中的专利转让与72种FFV产品相关联。实证结果表明，从创新者向受让国每转移一项额外专利，受让国对创新者的出口增加，主要通过扩展边际的增长实现。运输阶段的技术有助于技术受让国进入出口市场，其对出口的影响强于生产阶段的创新。结果在PPML、OLS、滞后OLS及IV估计中均保持稳健。总体而言，研究结果凸显了国际技术扩散在降低进入壁垒和促进易腐商品贸易中的关键作用。
title: Diffusing Freshness: International Technology Transfers and Trade in Fresh Fruits and Vegetables
title_zh: 扩散新鲜度：国际技术转移与新鲜果蔬贸易

abstract: Floods are among the costliest and most recurring natural hazards. Many governments provide disaster preparedness information, but there is limited evidence of its effectiveness. Using a randomized experiment across 300 urban communities in Mozambique, I show that providing information on flood risk increased the implementation of suggested mitigation strategies, measured objectively (using a machine learning-based algorithm to detect solid waste, a major flood hazard, in over 25,000 photos) and through self-reported behaviors. Sending flood preparedness text messages proved to be at least as effective as more resource-intensive interventions that involved household visits and video screenings. Risk perception increased, particularly in lower-risk areas, suggesting that information and past experiences contribute to community preparedness by shaping perceived flood risk. These findings highlight the importance of communication in mobilizing communities for disaster risk management, even in contexts where flood risks are presumably already well-known, and underscore the potential of low-cost, scalable communication tools.
abstract_zh: 洪水是最为昂贵且频发的自然灾害之一。许多政府提供防灾准备信息，但关于其有效性的证据有限。通过在莫桑比克300个城市社区进行的随机实验，我展示了提供洪水风险信息能增加建议缓解策略的实施，这一效果通过客观测量（利用基于机器学习的算法在超过25,000张照片中检测固体废物，这是主要的洪水隐患）及自我报告行为得以证实。发送洪水准备短信被证明至少与涉及家访和视频放映的资源密集型干预措施同样有效。风险感知有所提升，尤其是在低风险区域，这表明信息和过往经历通过塑造感知到的洪水风险，促进了社区的准备工作。这些发现强调了沟通在动员社区参与灾害风险管理中的重要性，即便在洪水风险可能已被广泛认知的情境下，也凸显了低成本、可扩展沟通工具的潜力。
title: It will rain: The effect of information on flood preparedness in urban Mozambique
title_zh: 降雨将至：信息对莫桑比克城市洪水防备的影响

abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have the potential to profoundly transform and enrich experimental economic research. We propose a new software framework, “alter_ego”, which makes it easy to design experiments between LLMs and to integrate LLMs into oTree-based experiments with human subjects. Our toolkit is freely available at github.com/mrpg/ego . To illustrate, we run differently framed prisoner’s dilemmas with interacting machines as well as with human-machine interaction. Framing effects in machine-only treatments are strong and similar to those expected from previous human-only experiments, yet less pronounced and qualitatively different if machines interact with human participants.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）具有深刻变革和丰富实验经济学研究的潜力。我们提出了一种新的软件框架"alter_ego"，该框架能够便捷地设计LLMs之间的实验，并将其整合到基于oTree平台、涉及人类被试的实验中。我们的工具包可在github.com/mrpg/ego免费获取。为进行说明，我们通过机器间交互以及人机交互的方式，运行了不同框架设定的囚徒困境实验。在纯机器处理组中，框架效应显著且与以往纯人类实验的预期结果相似；但当机器与人类被试交互时，框架效应则较弱且存在质性差异。
title: Integrating machine behavior into human subject experiments: a user-friendly toolkit and an application to framed prisoner’s dilemmas
title_zh: 将机器行为融入人类被试实验：一个用户友好型工具包及其在框架囚徒困境中的应用

abstract: This paper develops a theory in which the degree of automation in the aggregate economy emerges endogenously as an equilibrium outcome and can be inferred from standard macroeconomic data. We define the degree of automation as the share of tasks performed by capital rather than labor and embed it in a task-based production framework with endogenous technology adoption. Aggregating task-level decisions generates a CES production function in which the economy-wide degree of automation emerges endogenously. This structure provides a transparent mapping from standard macroeconomic observables, such as the capital-labor ratio, output per worker, and the elasticity of substitution, into the degree of automation, allowing automation to be measured without relying on technology-specific indicators. Applying the framework to Japanese manufacturing industries, we show that automation increased through capital deepening even during periods of slow productivity growth. abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个理论框架，其中经济总体自动化程度作为均衡结果内生形成，并可通过标准宏观经济数据推断得出。我们将自动化程度定义为资本而非劳动执行的任务份额，并将其嵌入一个包含内生技术采纳的任务型生产框架中。通过加总任务层面的决策，我们推导出包含内生经济总体自动化程度的CES生产函数。该结构建立了从标准宏观经济可观测变量（如资本劳动比、人均产出和替代弹性）到自动化程度的透明映射关系，使得无需依赖特定技术指标即可衡量自动化水平。将该框架应用于日本制造业部门后，我们发现即使在生产率增长缓慢时期，自动化仍通过资本深化过程持续提升。
title: The macroeconomics of automation

abstract: This paper uses a large individual‐record‐level dataset on sick leave to examine adult morbidity in the United Kingdom between 1850 and 1908. From 1859 onwards postal workers were eligible to receive a pension or gratuity when they retired or were forced to stop working due to ill health. Their pension application forms contain information on up to 10 years of sick leave taken prior to retirement by each retiree. These data have several advantages over previous sources of information on morbidity in this period. Sick leave was closely monitored by the Post Office's medical service, mitigating issues around the inflation of morbidity raised in the context of friendly society data; they cover the entirety of the United Kingdom; they include workers from the service sector as well as manufacturing occupations; and they include a greater proportion and number of women than previous sources. The paper discusses the nature of these data and the administrative systems that created them before examining the trends and modelling the determinants of sick leave. It concludes that postal workers became increasingly likely to take time off during this period but that the duration of sick leave remained stable. These changes were driven by changes to sick leave regulations; shifts in the composition of the workforce by age, occupation, gender, and location; and changes in the intensity of postal work.
abstract_zh: 本文利用一份涵盖1850至1908年间英国病假记录的大型个体层面数据集，考察了该时期的成人发病率。自1859年起，邮政工作人员在退休或因健康原因被迫停止工作时，有资格领取养老金或一次性补助金。他们的养老金申请表格中包含了每位退休人员在退休前长达10年的病假记录。与这一时期其他发病率信息来源相比，这些数据具有多项优势。邮政部门的医疗服务机构对病假进行了严格监控，从而缓解了友好社会数据中关于发病率虚增的问题；这些数据覆盖了整个英国；不仅包括制造业职业，还涵盖了服务业工作者；并且相较于以往来源，包含了更多数量和比例的女性。本文首先探讨了这些数据的性质及其产生的行政体系，随后分析了病假趋势并构建了其决定因素的模型。研究得出结论，在此期间，邮政工作人员请假的可能性逐渐增加，但病假持续时间保持稳定。这些变化受到病假规定调整、劳动力在年龄、职业、性别和地域构成上的变化，以及邮政工作强度变化等因素的驱动。
title: Sick leave in the United Kingdom Post Office, 1850–1908
title_zh: 英国邮政局病假制度研究（1850–1908）

abstract: Abstract Experimental methods have gained significant traction in agricultural economics in recent decades through the growing use of laboratory experiments, lab‐in‐the‐field studies, and experimental designs embedded in online surveys. However, replicability remains a persistent challenge and a critical benchmark for rigor in experimental economics research. Previous studies showed a strong correlation between statistical power and replicability, highlighting the importance of combining sample size with optimal study design to maximize power in experimental economics research. Despite power analysis being well established in randomized controlled trials, experimental economists have had to rely on rules of thumb (e.g., allocate equal number of subjects to each group), which may not guarantee optimal power. In this study, we propose an adaptive treatment assignment procedure to improve statistical power in experimental studies, using an experimental design that updates the researcher's beliefs about the standard deviation ratio of outcomes under different treatments. We simulate experimental data collection under different updating rules to test the expected gains in power compared to the naïve (conventional) method of equal treatment assignment. Our results show significant gains in power under our proposed adaptive procedures compared to equal treatment assignment. These gains in power are directly proportional to the standard deviation ratio between treatments. Importantly, the power achieved under our proposed adaptive treatment assignment procedures was consistently almost identical to the maximum theoretical power achievable given the study parameters. We thus provide a practical and easy‐to‐use tool that can help researchers optimize treatment assignment in their experimental studies to maximize power.
abstract_zh: 摘要 近几十年来，通过实验室实验、实地实验室研究和嵌入在线调查的实验设计的日益普及，实验方法在农业经济学中获得了显著关注。然而，可复制性仍然是实验经济学研究中一个持续的挑战，也是衡量严谨性的关键基准。以往研究表明，统计功效与可复制性之间存在强相关性，凸显了在实验经济学研究中将样本量与最优研究设计相结合以最大化功效的重要性。尽管功效分析在随机对照试验中已得到充分确立，但实验经济学家不得不依赖经验法则（例如，将相同数量的受试者分配到各组），这可能无法保证最优功效。在本研究中，我们提出了一种自适应处理分配程序，以提高实验研究中的统计功效，该实验设计会更新研究者对不同处理下结果标准差比率的信念。我们模拟了不同更新规则下的实验数据收集过程，以检验与朴素（传统）等量处理分配方法相比，功效的预期提升。我们的结果显示，与等量处理分配相比，我们提出的自适应程序在功效方面有显著提升。这些功效提升与处理间的标准差比率成正比。重要的是，在我们提出的自适应处理分配程序下实现的功效，始终与给定研究参数下可达到的最大理论功效几乎一致。因此，我们提供了一个实用且易于使用的工具，可帮助研究人员优化其实验研究中的处理分配，以最大化功效。
title: Maximizing experimental power through dynamic treatment assignment
title_zh: 通过动态处理分配最大化实验效力

abstract: This paper investigates how cashless payment affects credit access for underserved populations using data from Alipay, a leading Chinese BigTech platform with over 1 billion users that offers a wide range of financial services. By exploiting the staggered rollout of Alipay-bundled shared bikes across cities as a natural experiment and analyzing a representative Alipay user sample, I find that cashless payment adoption increases credit access by 56.3% and that a 1% rise in payment flow increases credit lines by 0.41%. These effects are stronger for less educated and older individuals, who have traditionally faced greater barriers to accessing financial services.
abstract_zh: 本文利用中国领先的BigTech平台——支付宝（拥有超过10亿用户，提供广泛金融服务）的数据，探讨无现金支付如何影响弱势群体的信贷获取。通过将支付宝捆绑共享单车在各城市的逐步推广作为自然实验，并分析具有代表性的支付宝用户样本，我发现无现金支付的采纳使信贷获取增加了56.3%，且支付流量每增加1%，信贷额度相应提高0.41%。这些效应在受教育程度较低及年龄较大的个体中更为显著，而这一群体历来在获取金融服务方面面临更大障碍。

title: Cashless payment and financial inclusion
title_zh: 无现金支付与金融包容性

abstract: We analyze optimal procurement contracts when suppliers learn about project costs over time and retain an ex-post right to exit. In the first period, the firm observes a private signal on the likelihood of high costs; in the second, it learns the realized cost type and decides whether to continue or exercise its outside option. We show that when exit opportunities are sufficiently attractive, the optimal mechanism pools all first-period signals and reduces to a cost-plus contract, with payments tied only to realized, verifiable costs. Attempts to elicit cost forecasts ex-ante backfire: firms strategically under-report expectations, triggering exit in high-cost states and generating overruns. This provides a mechanism-based interpretation of cost overruns as failures of incentive design. Finally, we demonstrate that more generous outside options can raise procurement costs and lower firm profits, identifying conditions where limiting exit rights is ex-ante Pareto improving. (JEL D82, D86, H57)
abstract_zh: 我们分析了当供应商随时间了解项目成本并保留事后退出权时的最优采购合同。在第一阶段，企业观察到关于高成本可能性的私人信号；在第二阶段，它了解到实现的成本类型，并决定是继续还是行使外部选择权。我们表明，当退出机会足够有吸引力时，最优机制会汇集所有第一阶段的信号，并简化为成本加成合同，其中支付仅与已实现且可验证的成本挂钩。试图事前获取成本预测会适得其反：企业策略性地低估预期，导致高成本状态下退出并产生超支。这为成本超支作为激励设计失败提供了一种基于机制的解释。最后，我们证明更慷慨的外部选择权可以提高采购成本并降低企业利润，确定了限制退出权在事前帕累托改进的条件。（JEL D82, D86, H57）
title: The effect of exit rights on cost-based procurement contracts
title_zh: 退出权对成本型采购合同的影响
